candidates.description: This vector is related to German language morphology, vocabulary, and proper nouns.
This feature activates on words and proper nouns related to World War II, fascist regimes, and political history.
These tokens function as grammatical articles and common prepositions in Germanic languages, primarily German and Dutch.
This vector represents suffixes or root components of Latin-derived words, particularly those ending in variations of "-clus", "-cis", or "-cad".
This vector is related to Latin-derived derivational suffixes expressing states, actions, or relational outcomes (-sion, -tion, -uent).
This feature vector represents the linguistic root or prefix "anti-" and words or sub-word fragments containing the phonetic sequence "ant".
This feature vector represents terms associated with national, international, and political organizations or movements.
This vector represents word fragments, tokens, and entities starting with the letters "ass" or "assoc".
This vector represents dynamic transitive and intransitive English action and state verbs.
This vector represents morphological noun suffixes and abbreviation markers across multiple languages.
